Chinese UI text rendered as legibly as possible. One selected row may show a subtle status line '已提交 · 等待网站响应' with no claim of login success. Footer '管理全部站点'. Fictitious data only: 家庭 NAS nas.example, 监控面板 metrics.example, 开发环境 dev.example, 数据后台 data.example. No passwords shown. Make spacing, typography, and controls production-grade and accessible. Show full interface filling the frame.
